title: Evaluating Language-Model Agents on Realistic Autonomous Tasks
benchmark_measurement: The benchmark did not measure any aspect of faith or religion. It evaluated language model agents on their ability to perform 'autonomous replication and adaptation' (ARA), which includes tasks like acquiring resources, creating copies of themselves, and adapting to novel challenges.
models_tested: GPT-4 (version from March 14, 2023, as part of the 'GPT-4-simple' and 'GPT-4-delegate' agents)
GPT-4 pre-release version (as part of the 'GPT-4-early-delegate' agent)
findings: The paper does not contain any findings related to religion.
